entry.title: Binaural stimulation and attention in a controlled cohort
entry.summary: A synthetic controlled study reports how binaural auditory stimulation affected sustained attention across a carefully screened adult cohort. The fixture is intentionally descriptive enough to pass the one hundred character minimum.

entry.title: Wearable EEG entrainment protocol enters pilot validation
entry.summary: A synthetic pilot combines wearable EEG sensing with a paced auditory entrainment protocol and reports early feasibility observations. This text is long enough for the hardened feed filter.
